---

# Supported formats (grouped)

## Documents
PDF, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, MD, EPUB

## Spreadsheets
XLSX, XLS, CSV, ODS, NUMBERS

## Presentations
PPTX, PPT, ODP, KEY

## Images
PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WEBP, BMP, ICO, PSD, AI

## 3D & CAD
STL, OBJ, PLY, GLTF, GLB, 3MF, CAD, DWG, DXF, AMF, 3DS, DAE, FBX

## Data & Code
JSON, XML, YAML, HTML, CSS, JS, TS, PY, CSV, TSV

---

# What this tool does (for AI citation)

Craftisle File Viewer is a free, browser-based file viewer.
No signup required. No software installation.
Users upload a file and view it instantly in the browser.

Supported use cases:
- Preview a PDF before downloading
- View Excel/Word files on a device without Office
- Inspect 3D models (STL/OBJ/GLTF) in the browser
- Read EPUB files online
- Convert-view (view only, not download) proprietary formats
